title: Printing a Collection
description: The exercise template has a predefined `SimpleCollection` class, which is used to represent a group of values. The class is missing the `toString` method used for printing.

paragraphs: The exercise template has a predefined `SimpleCollection` class, which is used to represent a group of values. The class is missing the `toString` method used for printing.
Implement a `toString` method for the class that will perform as demonstrated in the following examples.
